problems.title: Peak Active Jobs

generationMetadata.conceptSummary: Determine peak overlap among half-open job intervals without scanning the full timeline.

problems.description: Two equal-length arrays describe jobs. Job i is active on the half-open interval [starts[i], starts[i] + durations[i]). Return the largest number of jobs active at the same instant. A job ending at time t is not active when another job starts at t. The input order is arbitrary.

examples.explanation: At most two half-open intervals overlap; the job ending at 4 does not overlap the job starting at 4.

problems.title: Dispatch Batch Ceiling

generationMetadata.conceptSummary: Minimize the largest contiguous batch cost when adjacent jobs within a batch add a setup overhead.

problems.description: Jobs must be dispatched in their given order using at most batches nonempty contiguous batches. A batch containing jobs i through j costs the sum of their loads plus setup for every adjacent pair inside that batch, so its cost is sum(loads[i..j]) + setup * (j - i). Return the minimum possible value of the maximum batch cost.
constraints: The answer fits the supported long range

examples.explanation: Batches [4, 2] and [7, 3] cost 7 and 11, and no other split has a lower maximum.
